answer: The wander schedule is applied in vault and garden makes public each instalment. A payout is split which means 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An hostile operator therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4002 identities would post 2125 proofs and burn roughly 10 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
